title: Baked image manifest (<image id>.json next to the qcow2; /etc/shipshape/image.json inside it)
description: Written by ship/image/bake (phase 4); read by FleetLedger (`ship-fleet image`). See contracts/image.md.

id.description: <ubuntu release>-<bake date, UTC>-<first 8 hex of inputs_sha256>.

versions_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the versions.toml the bake installed from.

inputs_sha256.description: SHA-256 over the base image hash, versions.toml, the baked recipes, ship-provision and the bake scripts: the same inputs give the same id suffix.

recipes.description: Recipes marked bake whose system parts (apt packages) are in the image.

packages.description: apt packages the bake installed on top of the cloud image.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the finished qcow2. Only in the copy next to the file (the image cannot hold its own hash).

timestamp.description: UTC, RFC 3339, with a Z suffix.
